scope: bounded refresh of prior 19 selected clusters

historical_audit.method: 12 title terms each queried independently for created issues and merged PRs; Sep30 UTC slack handles Bangkok boundary; first100 most-recently-updated hits per query. Regex mechanical screen then selected full-body/cross-reference checks. Not a census.

changes_from_prior_snapshot.detail: The 10 historical open-report clusters, 7 qualifying merged clusters/8 product PRs, and 2 excluded merged candidates retain their prior states.
Open update-lock salvage candidate surfaced by bounded timeline and confirmed to reference the selected issue; no merged-fix credit added.
Issues #139532 and #147387 remain open while their prior audited fix PRs are merged. Neither is added to the 10 wholly unresolved report clusters.
Cross-references are kept separate: process PR #157340, prior related changes, unrelated plugin-catalog PR #151272, and additional proposals do not inflate incident/fix counts.

limitations: This is a refresh of the prior selected sample, not an exhaustive issue or PR census.
Public issue and PR lifecycle metadata was refreshed; prior qualitative incident/recovery classifications were retained. Issue bodies/comments were not re-audited for new behavioral evidence.
Cross-reference timelines were bounded to the latest 50 selected event types per issue; none reported a previous page. A cross-reference does not establish a fix.
No native test, current release-candidate reproduction, release containment check, live provider inference, or customer session was executed.
Historical report-evidenced UX P0 qualification is separate from current release-blocker status; open lifecycle is not current failure proof and merge is not current native recovery proof.
Prior excluded candidates M3 and M8 remain recovery-ambiguous and excluded from the qualifying historical lower bound.

clusters.title: Windows fixture-copy failure in install/update
clusters.reported_user_flow: Source installation or dependency-sync repeatedly fails on bundled conformance fixtures; updater may exit 0 and leave Desktop build owed/gateway stopped.
clusters.reported_recovery: Installer reporter recovered only by enabling OS long paths as administrator and rebooting; updater reporter says ordinary retry fails. #151274 is corroborating MSIX/plugin evidence, not a separate core-flow count.
clusters.evidence_limit: Some root-cause uncertainty remains: #156983 cannot reproduce its failure with isolated copy; group as one fixture-copy family to avoid inflation.

clusters.title: Windows Desktop update never relaunches
clusters.reported_user_flow: In-app Update reaches Code updated, then waits indefinitely; no result marker or Desktop relaunch.
clusters.reported_recovery: Reported verified recipe kills processes, reruns CLI update with --no-gateway-restart, starts the scheduled task, and removes a stale pending marker.
clusters.evidence_limit: Open fix #156237; no current native proof inspected.

clusters.title: Interrupted Windows update destroys recoverability
clusters.reported_user_flow: Updater/gateway wait on one another; interruption leaves an empty venv and Desktop boot loop.
clusters.reported_recovery: Reporter recovered through manual environment rebuilding and marker cleanup.
clusters.evidence_limit: Distinct from O2: incomplete environment after interruption, rather than final hand-off watchdog failure; exact shared ancestry is unproven.

related_pull_requests.evidence: PR title and body reference selected issue #149520; remains open; implementation effectiveness unverified

clusters.title: Windows reboot strands Telegram
clusters.reported_user_flow: A pre-reboot scoped lock is treated as live; the new gateway parks Telegram and inbound messages get no answer.
clusters.reported_recovery: Deleting the lock manually and then restarting gateway restored binding; restart alone did not help.
clusters.evidence_limit: Reproduced report on v0.23.1; no current candidate run.

clusters.title: Non-ASCII Windows profile blocks first install
clusters.reported_user_flow: Hermes-Setup always fails the first System prerequisites stage: UTF-8 git path is decoded as OEM text.
clusters.reported_recovery: Only forced UTF-8 script execution or an ASCII-only LOCALAPPDATA path recovers; ordinary retries repeat failure.
clusters.evidence_limit: One cluster; open fix #148568. This differs from merged incomplete-Git fix #145592: these reports confirm the extracted helper exists.

clusters.title: Slow version probe treats healthy Desktop install as absent
clusters.reported_user_flow: Desktop boot times out a 15-second hermes --version probe, falls into setup and may quit; real install/gateway remain healthy.
clusters.reported_recovery: Later manual relaunch can work; blobless-clone reporter used git fetch or disabled passive update checks. No Desktop Retry repairs the failed path.
clusters.evidence_limit: P0 basis is Linux #155862: manual git fetch or config change is required. Earlier macOS #148498 is corroboration only because a later normal relaunch sometimes recovered; do not impose a macOS hold from that report alone. One false-absence probe family; open #150540.

clusters.title: Smart App Control update leaves gateway down
clusters.reported_user_flow: Windows update rewires launchers to a blocked Python 3.14 interpreter despite dependency failure; Desktop falls into setup and messaging stops.
clusters.reported_recovery: Reporter manually repointed launch scripts/interpreter; normal follow-up could reapply the broken runtime.
clusters.evidence_limit: Conditional supported Windows security-policy path; no policy bypass is proposed.

clusters.title: Subagent route corrupts returning Desktop Bot Chat
clusters.reported_user_flow: After async delegation, persisted routing points the parent Bot Chat at a subagent; every resume/delivery returns admission_conflict.
clusters.reported_recovery: Gateway restart does not help; reporter repaired the route by hand.
clusters.evidence_limit: Open fix #155020; observed once, not intentionally reproduced.

clusters.title: Windows logon task reports success without gateway
clusters.reported_user_flow: PM Python-3.14 scheduled-task autostart returns success but starts no gateway; messaging remains unavailable after logon.
clusters.reported_recovery: Only a manually added console-owning Startup-folder script works in the report.
clusters.evidence_limit: Open fix #136397; distinct from O4 because no gateway launches, rather than a launched gateway refusing Telegram.

clusters.title: Source Desktop update
clusters.reported_user_flow: CLI update succeeds but running/installed source Desktop remains stale; About says latest stable and offers only Get the installer.
clusters.reported_recovery: Fully quit Desktop, rerun hermes update in Terminal, reopen; installed commit matched runtime and warning cleared.
clusters.evidence_limit: Prior native stable reproduction on v0.23.1 to v0.23.2 at 2026-11-18T09:22:09Z; no new native run. Product fix #128465 remains open. #157340 is process/test coverage.

clusters.title: Profile OAuth false success
clusters.reported_user_flow: First profile auth add says Added but discards the credential or loses it on next load.
clusters.reported_recovery: Repeated add/re-login did not persist; fix stores the independent profile grant and checks readback.
clusters.evidence_limit: Origins #103694 (Sep 5), #120177 (Sep 23), #125501 (Sep 27) are pre-window; counted by Oct 7 merged fix.

clusters.title: Valid Anthropic Console key sent as OAuth
clusters.reported_user_flow: Valid Console API keys produce credit-balance errors and credential quarantine, blocking provider first reply.
clusters.reported_recovery: Re-entering the same valid key cannot change misclassification; fix selects x-api-key.
clusters.evidence_limit: PR reports red/green tests and wire probe; live paid inference not independently rerun.

clusters.title: Installed CLI disappears in new login shell
clusters.reported_user_flow: Installer says complete, but hermes is not found in new login-bash terminals when .bash_login shadows .profile.
clusters.reported_recovery: Fix writes the guarded PATH line to the startup file Bash actually reads; prior normal reopen repeated failure.
clusters.evidence_limit: No public issue for this exact residual case; PR is the incident/evidence source.

clusters.title: CLI provider re-login advice cannot work
clusters.reported_user_flow: External-process provider auth failure tells user to run auth add even though provider ships no auth_handler.
clusters.reported_recovery: Suggested command fails; fix points to hermes model, which invokes vendor CLI login.
clusters.evidence_limit: Older source PR #121401 (Sep 24) closed unmerged; merged salvage is Nov 9. No end-user login was rerun here.

clusters.title: Windows install caches incomplete Git forever
clusters.reported_user_flow: Short file lock leaves a partial Git; every installer retry reuses it and cannot download HTTPS.
clusters.reported_recovery: Fix detects broken cached helper and re-extracts atomically; native Windows PR proof shows HTTPS probe exit 128 before and 0 after.
clusters.evidence_limit: Different mechanism from O5 non-ASCII decoding.

clusters.title: Packaged macOS update downloads but never installs
clusters.reported_user_flow: ShipIt aborts on read-only baked pycs, exhausts three attempts and returns to old app.
clusters.reported_recovery: Fix makes update payload pycs owner-writable; repeated normal updates otherwise repeat the abort.
clusters.evidence_limit: Merged verified; PR explicitly says a real ShipIt install was not verified. Not the source-install carry-in #123737.

clusters.title: Remote Desktop cannot create any new chat
clusters.reported_user_flow: Public-ticket remote Desktop sends legacy-shaped requests to canonical session authority; every new chat fails invalid_params.
clusters.reported_recovery: Fix negotiates authority wire from gateway.ready. Normal retry cannot change protocol.
clusters.evidence_limit: PR includes real remote confirmation on v0.22.6 and client regressions; not a current release smoke.

clusters.title: Gated remote Desktop rejects correct token on REST
clusters.reported_user_flow: Desktop session-token connection has repeated 401s for history/roster despite correct deployment token; returning history is unavailable.
clusters.reported_recovery: Fix accepts the Desktop header via the session-token provider; re-entering a correct token did not change gate behavior.
clusters.evidence_limit: #147387 remains open but #148797/#149587/#149623 are merged. Chat WS already worked on main per this fix: scope is REST/history, not a proven total chat outage.

clusters.title: Lost turn silently pauses returning conversation
clusters.reported_user_flow: Gateway restart fences a turn unknown; queued follow-up waits forever, and relaunch elsewhere hides the recovery card.
clusters.reported_recovery: Automation is settled as interrupted; every supported surface gains discard; Desktop reconnect/relaunch surfaces Needs your input and Discard runs queued send exactly once.
clusters.evidence_limit: One cluster, two merged PRs. #139532 is open, but is not counted as wholly unresolved after these fixes. Current messaging/multiplex native proof remains limited.
